requirement: Write a function is_prime(n) that returns True if n is a prime number and False otherwise. Handle n less than 2 correctly.

acceptance_criteria.text: For any integer n less than 2, is_prime returns False.
For prime numbers (e.g., 2,3,5,7,11), is_prime returns True.
For composite numbers greater than or equal to 2 (e.g., 4,6,9,15), is_prime returns False.

tasks.description: Create the function stub is_prime(n) with proper signature.
Add a check that returns False when n is less than 2.
Implement a trial-division algorithm up to sqrt(n) to determine primality, returning True for primes and False for composites.
